evidence.explanation: The supplied registry contains historical verified-live claims and direct URLs, but this session has no web-search, HTTP, browser, Camofox, or web-extraction capability. Those historical claims cannot be independently rechecked. Reporting a completed discovery run or claiming fresh verification would therefore be unsupported.

required_follow_up.action: Repeat source discovery with live retrieval enabled.
minimum_acceptance_evidence: An accessible current listing or public API response from the candidate host.
At least one current QA, Quality Assurance, Software Test, or Test Automation vacancy applicable to Germany.
A direct detail record confirming the role, employer, location, and application destination.
Independent listing and detail retrieval, preferably using two methods, before registry approval.
